Interim Results Announcement

Summary by AI BETAClose X

WH Smith PLC reported a 5% increase in total Group revenue to £748 million for the six months ended 28 February 2026, driven by a 10% rise in North America and 8% in the Rest of the World, though UK revenue grew only 2%. Headline Group profit before tax decreased significantly to £3 million from £21 million in the prior year, with headline trading profit falling to £32 million from £47 million, impacting diluted EPS to (0.8)p from 11.5p. The company has suspended its dividend to strengthen its financial position and is adopting a cautious outlook for the full year, expecting headline profit before tax between £90 million and £105 million due to geopolitical uncertainties.
